title: Load Tender Checklist
subtitle: Load Tender: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Load Tender Checklist covers offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance. The transport planning coordinator records Load Tender criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Load Tender Checklist keeps Load Tender exceptions visible until the transport planning coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Load Tender Checklist at origin, destination, route, pickup window, delivery window, and equipment location. Document offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance identity before Load Tender begins. Compare offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance findings with stated Load Tender criteria; route unresolved Load Tender issues to authorized carrier-management reviewer. For Load Tender Checklist, confirm requirements for Load Tender. Ask authorized carrier-management reviewer to review Load Tender conditions beyond the transport planning coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Load Tender, identify responsible parties, origin, destination, route, pickup window, delivery window, and equipment location, and the linked offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance source.

fields.label: Equipment, commodity, quantity, weight, and handling references

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Load Tender facts for offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Load Tender inspection checks
items: Acceptance, rejection, counteroffer, and dispatch handoff

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Load Tender finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Transport Planning Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Rate or instruction changed without authority
blocks.guidance: Pause Load Tender when carrier, capacity, equipment, commitment, rate, or instruction authorization remains unresolved. Retain the available Load Tender proof and route unresolved offered load, carrier capacity, equipment, route, rate, handling requirement, and acceptance scope to transport planning coordinator.
